test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_wtkp (p UInt64, o UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_wtkp_wide (p UInt64, o UInt64, c1 UInt64, c2 UInt64, c3 UInt64, c4 UInt64, c5 UInt64, c6 UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_wtkp_unique (p UInt64, o UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_wtkp_small (p UInt64, o UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_wtkp_str (p String, o String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE t_wtkp_mt (p UInt64, o UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY o PARTITION BY p % 16
CREATE TABLE t_wtkp_ord (p UInt64, o UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (p, o)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_wtkp SELECT number % 100, cityHash64(number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO t_wtkp_wide SELECT number % 100, cityHash64(number), number, number * 2, number * 3, number * 5, number * 7, number * 11, toString(number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO t_wtkp_unique SELECT number, cityHash64(number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO t_wtkp_small SELECT number % 2000000, cityHash64(number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO t_wtkp_str SELECT toString(number % 200000), toString(cityHash64(number)) FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
INSERT INTO t_wtkp_mt SELECT number % 100, cityHash64(number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO t_wtkp_ord SELECT number % 100, cityHash64(number) FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT p, o, rk FROM (SELECT p, o, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS rk FROM t_wtkp) WHERE rk <= 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT p, o FROM (SELECT p, o, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS rn FROM t_wtkp) WHERE rn <= 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS rk FROM t_wtkp_wide) WHERE rk <= 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT p, o, rk FROM (SELECT p, o, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS rk FROM t_wtkp_unique) WHERE rk <= 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT p, o, rk FROM (SELECT p, o, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS rk FROM t_wtkp_small) WHERE rk <= 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT p, o, rk FROM (SELECT p, o, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS rk FROM t_wtkp_str) WHERE rk <= 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT p, s FROM (SELECT p, sum(o) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS s, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY o DESC) AS rk FROM t_wtkp) WHERE rk <= 10 FORMAT Null
